name: Enforcement and Liability Gap
definition: A rule exists and cannot be enforced, or no recognized person bears the obligation, so liability has nowhere to attach.
trigger_conditions: No legal person is identifiable behind the agent
The obligated party is outside the reach of any enforcing authority
Sanction depends on a party that can exit at will

institutional_antecedent.mechanism: procedural correctness failing to substitute for an accountable party

citation: W. A. Kaal, ed., Agent Failure Mode Registry version 1.0, AFMR-F032 Enforcement and Liability Gap. https://wulfkaal.github.io/afmr/AFMR-F032
assessment_note: State which trigger conditions the assessed design satisfies. Report this family as examined even where no exposure is found. A parameter recommendation stated without its conditions is not conforming output under section 7.
